Native functional estimation, inference and simulation exports

etr_native_release_inference_exports.Rd

Reference index for exported functions in this scientific domain. The functions are independently callable; scientific scope and input contracts vary by estimator, data structure, fitted object, and selected backend.

Details

These functions expose explicit native or alternative functional-data model fits, projection/score uncertainty, simulation and model sensitivity. Bootstrap and inference functions require their documented experimental units, fitted source structures, resampling rules and supported numerical domains. The existence of a source-name mapping is not an independent full-domain Python 1.2 parity certificate. Review estimator-specific technical documentation, assumptions and corresponding R/source tests before scientific reporting; particular uncertainty methods may be research-only with no external coverage validation. For joint mixed-effects bootstrap fits, random_state accepts exactly represented nonnegative integer seeds below \(2^{53}\). Explicit seeds use NumPy-compatible PCG64 draws. A supplied zero-based draw matrix takes precedence. A null seed uses the ambient R stream.

Exported entry points

etr_bootstrap_fpca_component_envelopes

bootstrap fpca component envelopes – descriptive matched-bootstrap FPC pointwise envelopes. Optional bootstrap_unit_indices provides zero-based fixed curve/participant unit draws for deterministic source replay, without claiming Python NumPy RNG or full-domain parity.

etr_bootstrap_fpca_regression_uncertainty

bootstrap fpca regression uncertainty – an explicit exported method; consult its R formal arguments and source-contract restrictions.

etr_bootstrap_functional_mixed_effects_coefficients

Whole-participant conditional Gaussian GLS resampling for native joint B-spline likelihood fits with complete observed-time covariance and fixed variance components; older mixed-moments records retain their scientifically distinct timewise approximation. A zero-based source-index matrix supports deterministic Python 1.2 replay.

etr_bootstrap_functional_mixed_effects_full_refit

Whole-participant full native Gaussian ML/REML refits for joint B-spline random-intercept models with iid residuals; estimates random-intercept covariance and residual variance in each fitted replicate. Structured joint likelihood models additionally support native AR1/exponential serial residual, participant random-slope, nested functional trial and nested-slope full refits; these additional models require slow-gated local validation and remain uncertified. Mixed-moments records retain their separate estimator. No Python backend parity or external certification is claimed.

etr_bootstrap_generalized_function_on_scalar_coefficients

Whole-participant GEE refits. Explicit PCG64 seeds accept exactly represented nonnegative integers below \(2^{53}\). A supplied zero-based draw matrix takes precedence.

etr_fit_elastic_fpca

fit elastic fpca – an explicit exported method; consult its R formal arguments and source-contract restrictions.

etr_fit_generalized_function_on_scalar_regression

Working-independence clustered GEE with numeric, numeric-text or logical predictor columns. The default matches curve IDs. With python_boundary_mode = TRUE, supplied IDs must already follow trajectory order. Designs without a curve ID column must have default row names and follow the same order. This mode uses singular-value design rank and a separate GLM initialization. The declared maxiter and ctol then control GEE updates and the pre-update score norm. Participant coefficient bootstrap refits inherit the solver from the fitted model.

etr_fit_sparse_mfpca

fit sparse mfpca – an explicit exported method; consult its R formal arguments and source-contract restrictions.

etr_fpca_wild_bootstrap_projection_family_test

fpca wild bootstrap projection family test – an explicit exported method; consult its R formal arguments and source-contract restrictions.

etr_functional_mixed_effects_covariance_sensitivity

functional mixed effects covariance sensitivity – an explicit exported method; consult its R formal arguments and source-contract restrictions.

etr_scan_wild_bootstrap_fpca_truncations

Shares fixed or seeded wild draws across each candidate truncation. The multiplier controls are the same as for etr_wild_bootstrap_fpca_projection.

etr_simulate_functional_process

simulate functional process – an explicit exported method; consult its R formal arguments and source-contract restrictions.

etr_simulate_functional_scenario

simulate functional scenario – an explicit exported method; consult its R formal arguments and source-contract restrictions.

etr_wild_bootstrap_fpca_projection

Wild-bootstrap projection with normal or Mammen multipliers. A nonnegative integer seed below \(2^{53}\) uses NumPy-compatible PCG64 by default. random_engine = "base_R" can replay previous native normal draws. A fixed multiplier_draws matrix takes precedence. random_state = NULL uses the current R RNG stream.

Value

Each function returns its own documented native R, scientific-model, bridge, workflow or audit result; no single shared return type is asserted.
